document.summary: `groupWalk` orders overview then groups. Header and mobile chevrons, and `[` `]`, step that walk and stop at the ends.
document.why: [#70](source:s1) wants humans to move through existing groups without a tour document or a walkthrough script.

sources.title: Move group nav into the header
sources.gist: The bottom bar stole a row of the stage. Previous and next are icon-only controls in the existing header.

lookFor: [#70](source:s1) says walk existing groups only. Overview is on the walk so Next works from the start page. Unassigned and lockfiles are not.
[#70](source:s1) allows keyboard, chrome, or both. This diff ships `[` `]` and header chevrons. It does not add a tour document type.
The later request in [this session](source:s3) drops the bottom bar. `ReviewStage.tsx` is unchanged versus main. `GroupNav` mounts in `Header` and `MobileShell`.

groups.title: Neighbor walk
groups.why: [#70](source:s1) needs one ordered walk so chrome and keys share a neighbor, not a wrapping stack.
groups.summary: `groupWalk` and `neighborSelection` step overview then groups and return undefined at the ends.
lookFor: Subtle. From Unassigned or Lockfiles, previous returns the last group. Next from those buckets does nothing.

groups.title: Header and mobile chevrons
groups.why: [this session](source:s3) keeps chrome but not a footer. [e800140](source:s5) puts previous and next in the existing header.
groups.summary: `GroupNav` is icon-only. `Header` and `MobileShell` mount it. `App` passes selection into `Header`.
lookFor: The desktop chevrons sit in the header row next to `[` `]`. They do not add a second bar under the stage.

groups.title: Bracket keys follow the walk
groups.why: [#70](source:s1) allows keyboard. `[` and `]` must use the same neighbor as the chrome.
groups.summary: `App` calls `shiftSelection` on `[` and `]`, ignores key repeat, and calls preventDefault.
lookFor: Holding `]` does not skip groups. `event.repeat` is ignored.
